notes: S1 done (PR #591). S2 done (PR #592). S3a done (PR #593, direct sites 9->7). S3b done (PR #594, 7->6). S3c split in two: S3c-1 (this branch) migrates only ripple.get_report (analyst). The other two ripple tools are NOT mechanically migratable: predict_spread/validate_pmf signal a step timeout with RippleTimeoutError carrying job_id (callers use it to cancel the job and persist it for resume), and the Gateway flattens every failure into a string error, so the job_id would be lost; and they report soft failures as data ({"error": ...}), which the Gateway would record as ok=True (a dishonest trace). S3c-2 needs a domain-outcome channel on ToolResult first.
